resources.string: The streaming services, stores and prices this TV shows are this country\u2019s.
Swedish streaming services and stores (Viaplay, SVT Play, SF Anytime\u2026), prices in kronor, and what TMDB says is on in Sweden.
US streaming services and stores (Hulu, Peacock, Fandango at Home, Google TV\u2026), prices in dollars, and what TMDB says is on in the US.
Each region keeps its own store ticks; your streaming services stay ticked. Changing it rebuilds Home, and you come back here.
The streaming services and stores you tick next, and the currency of prices, are this country\u2019s: Sweden or the United States.
